summary.en: US futures rise on relief that U.S.-Iran hostilities paused, tech leading higher while oil plunges. AI financing momentum persists with Nvidia exploring $50B partnerships.
summary.zh: 美股期货因美伊停火传闻上涨，科技股领涨大盘，石油暴跌。AI 融资势头延续，NVIDIA 探索为数据中心提供 50 亿美元合作方案。

title.en: Trump Pauses US Strikes on Iran, Wall Street Futures Rally
title.zh: 特朗普暂停对伊朗空袭，美股期货上涨

impact.en: Ceasefire de-escalates geopolitical risk premium; energy underperforms. Gold rises on safe-haven flows.
impact.zh: 停火降低地缘风险溢价；能源股表现不及预期。黄金因避险资金流入而上涨。

title.en: Nvidia $250B Credit Backstop for OpenAI Ohio Data Center Project Unveiled
title.zh: 英伟达为美国 AI 俄亥俄数据中心项目提供 250 亿美元信用支持

impact.en: Corporate financing milestone validating massive data center CAPEX cycle with SoftBank involvement.
impact.zh: 企业融资里程碑级进展；验证了软银参与的大型数据中心资本开支周期。

title.en: WTI Oil Plunges 5% to $84.62 on Diplomatic Pause Despite Hormuz Blockade
title.zh: 西德克萨斯中质原油因外交暂停暴跌至每桶 84.62 美元，霍尔木兹海峡封锁仍持续

impact.en: Energy sector drawdown; inflation expectations ease but recession risks remain unpriced.
impact.zh: 能源板块显著回落；油价降低使通胀预期放缓，但衰退风险尚未计价。

title.en: Gold Futures Rise to $4,093 Amid Risk-On and Safe-Haven Confluence
title.zh: 黄金期货在风险偏好与避险情绪共振下上涨至每盎司 4,093

impact.en: Mixed signal: equity rally suggests growth confidence while metals hedge geopolitical uncertainty.
impact.zh: 混合信号：股市上涨表明对增长有信心，而金属投资者对冲地缘不确定性。

ai.en: AI surges on Nvidia $250B OpenAI backstop. Mega data center CAPEX validated with SoftBank.
ai.zh: 英伟达为美国 AI 提供的 250 亿美元支持推动 AI 板块上涨。软银参与验证了大型数据中心资本开支周期。

semiconductor.en: Broadcom and SK Hynix unveil $950B memory supply partnership with Nvidia. Korean stocks slip.
semiconductor.zh: 博通和美光与 NVIDIA 推出价值 9,500 亿美元内存供应合作方案，韩国股票出现下滑。

bigTech.en: Nasdaq futures up 1.2%. META posting gains ahead of earnings season.
bigTech.zh: 纳斯达克期货上涨 1.2%，META 在财报季前发布稳健收益。

energy.en: WTI -5% to $84.62 on diplomatic pause. XOM, CVX underperform amid Red Sea Houthi strikes.
energy.zh: 西德克萨斯中质原油因外交暂停暴跌至每桶 84.62 美元。在红海胡塞武装袭击持续情况下，美国石油巨头和雪佛龙表现疲软。

market.en: S&P futures +0.6% at 7,492; Nasdaq leads with +1.2%. Breadth improving.
market.zh: 标普期货上涨 0.6%，至 7,493；纳斯达克指数领涨，涨幅达 1.2%。广度改善。

preciousMetals.en: Gold up +0.6% to $4,093; Silver following with strength.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金上涨 0.6%，至每盎司 4,094；白银跟随走强。

oil.en: WTI -5% at $84.62; Brent down to ~$73 amid diplomatic truce but Hormuz blockade persists.
oil.zh: 西德克萨斯中质原油下跌至每桶 84.62 美元；布伦特跌至约 73 美元。

futures.en: SPX +0.6% at 7,492; NDQ +1.2%. Tech leading session.
futures.zh: 标普期货上涨至 7,493；纳斯达克领涨，涨幅达 1.2%，科技股主导。

oil.zh: 西德克萨斯中质原油 84.62(-5%)；布伦特约 73

keyRisk.en: Diplomatic pause fragile; Houthi strikes ongoing with Hormuz transit uncertainty.
keyRisk.zh: 停火脆弱，也门胡塞武装袭击持续。霍尔木兹海峡通行前景存不确定性。

note.en: Geopolitical de-escalation drives risk appetite. Tech financing milestones sustain rally.
note.zh: 地缘政治缓和提振风险偏好。科技融资里程碑支撑涨势延续。
